findings.issue: Three defects cause typecheck and test failures in pages.test.tsx: (1) line 342 calls h.store.scheduleCapture(CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY) with 1 argument, but Store.scheduleCapture() takes 0 arguments (TS2554); (2) in AC-6 (line 454), exportScene({ type: 'png', config: { embedScene: true } }) calls HTMLCanvasElement.prototype.toBlob which in JSDOM produces an empty non-PNG blob that fails PNG chunk decoding and times out after 5000ms; (3) in AC-7 (line 516), container.querySelector('.search-menu input') returns null because SearchMenu renders its input under `.${CLASSES.SEARCH_MENU_INPUT_WRAPPER} input` (and ListItem calls HTMLElement.prototype.scrollIntoView which is undefined in JSDOM unless mocked).
findings.fix: Call h.store.scheduleCapture() with 0 arguments at line 342; in AC-6, spy on HTMLCanvasElement.prototype.toBlob to pass a valid PNG fixture blob (`const basePng = await API.loadFile('./fixtures/smiley.png')`) before calling exportScene({ type: 'png', ... }) and restore the spy afterward; in AC-7, mock `window.HTMLElement.prototype.scrollIntoView = vi.fn()` and query `.${CLASSES.SEARCH_MENU_INPUT_WRAPPER} input` (importing CLASSES from @excalidraw/common).

findings.issue: In exportToBlob, the async callback passed to canvas.toBlob awaits encodePngMetadata without a try/catch block, so any error thrown during PNG metadata encoding results in an unhandled promise rejection and leaves the exportToBlob Promise unsettled forever.
findings.fix: Wrap the PNG embedScene block and resolve(blob) inside canvas.toBlob's async callback in a try { ... } catch (error) { reject(error); } block so errors properly reject the returned promise.

findings.issue: In loadSceneOrLibraryFromBlob, getScrollToContentState(data.elements || [], localAppState) is spread whenever localAppState is truthy, even when data.appState.pages is a non-empty multi-page array, overwriting the active page's saved scrollX/scrollY against U15 Rule 1.
findings.fix: Guard the getScrollToContentState spread with `localAppState && (!Array.isArray(data.appState?.pages) || data.appState.pages.length === 0)` so multi-page files preserve their saved per-page viewport.
